prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE Chinese heritage atlas fine-line illustration of Huangze Temple's actual photographed cliff niche with the central standing Buddha raising one hand, the two close monk attendants, and outer bodhisattvas; crop the photo's printed title and watermark away; preserve the visible old carved halos and robe folds. Image 1 supplies STYLE ONLY: sparse delicate black ink contours and generous white space, not its figure geometry. Image 2 supplies ACTUAL SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY; preserve figures' relative positions and surviving damage. landscape 1536×1024, centered, selected group entirely visible, even margins. An OPAQUE PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas at full opacity, black fine lines, all empty areas inside and outside figures white. Simplify minor details rather than fill with dense marks. No gray fills, shading, gradient, paper grain, color, halo added where none, cast shadow, transparent pixels, checkerboard, letters, labels, watermark, frame, tourists, fixtures or invented anatomy. A local script will remove the white background.
